Simple purées

More purée mixes

További pürévariációk

6 months+ Sound idea 20 min 1 portion

One mix on a well day is enough. Freeze the vegetable and meat mixes; eat the yogurt pair the same day.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 80 g first familiar food (cooked weight, peeled and pitted where needed)
  • 40 g second familiar food (cooked weight; a third food, if you add one, stays the smallest part)
  • 1 to 2 tbsp water (cooking water, only to loosen)
  • 2 tbsp plain pasteurised full-fat yogurt (only for the pear and yogurt pair; this is a milk allergen)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Choose two foods the baby already eats, or three at most.
  2. Cook them until soft, peel and pit as needed, and blend with a spoon of cooking water until smooth.
  3. Use pairs such as pumpkin and apple, broccoli and potato, and pea and sweet potato.
  4. Other sound pairs are zucchini and carrot, pear and plain yogurt, and chicken and pumpkin.
  5. Cook chicken through with no pink, and cook any vegetable until it mashes easily.
  6. There is no need to wait months between ordinary vegetables, and the yogurt pair is the one with a milk allergen.

Sound idea

Families sometimes wait months between ordinary vegetables for no nutritional reason. Yogurt, if you use that pair, is a milk allergen.

Cook and mix two familiar foods, three at most, once each has been eaten on its own. Ordinary vegetables do not need months between them, and only the pear and yogurt pair contains milk.
